operations.provenance: SM29 follow-up walkway-contact audit: the earlier y=104 reference was a diagonal brace crossing, not the horizontal support surface. The actual upper walkway begins at y=112. Decoded PN68 has opaque rows 4..25 with the same origin/foot geometry as PN67, so the captured draw at y=86 ends at y=111 and already rests directly above the walkway. Keep the collectible presentation at its captured vertical registration and leave the Classic pickup controller unchanged.

Move the controller -16px left and -8px up so its probe lands at [204,112], preserving the Classic 8px right-edge overhang while restoring authored terrain support.
